hook.text: A rooster crows before dawn. Does the rooster cause the sunrise? Obviously not—but the pattern tempts us.

buildup.text: False cause fallacies assume that because B follows A, A must have caused B.

discovery.text: Post hoc, ergo propter hoc: "after this, therefore because of this." Sequence isn't causation.

twist.text: Superstitions thrive on false cause. Wear lucky socks, win the game—confirmation bias does the rest.

climax.text: Proving causation requires controlled tests, not just timing. Correlation is just the starting clue.

quiz.question: What does 'post hoc ergo propter hoc' mean?
options: After this, therefore because of this
